dashboard.label: TA-psi Overview
dashboard.description: Collects PSI (pressure stall information) for CPU, memory and IO from /proc/pressure: some/full averages over 10s/60s/300s, including per-cgroup v2 pressure files when present.

search.query: index=main sourcetype="psi:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="psi.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="psi:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
